g.text: The Heart is the head office of Cardio Crew. It never
rests! It pumps blood to every part of the body, day
Arteries are wide and strong roads that carry
blood away from the heart to all parts of the
Blood is the delivery van. It carries oxygen,
nutrients, hormones, and other important things
to the cells and takes waste away.
Cells are the citizens of the body.
They get what they need to work,
play, and keep the body running.
Veins are the return roads. They bring
waste (like carbon dioxide) back to the
heart to clean it and send it out.
Lungs are the oxygen station. They take in fresh
air, add oxygen to the blood, and remove waste
Good habits keep the Cardio Crew happy
